summary: A hover-triggered card, in three shapes.

props.name: arrow
props.description: A pointer notched into the card's edge, aimed back at the trigger. It re-aims itself when the card flips to fit.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The inline content that opens the card on hover or focus.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Starting state when you are not controlling it. Pair `open` with `onOpenChange` instead if you are.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the new state. Required for a controlled preview card.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the card. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: animated
props.description: The card's fade in/out. Turn it off for an instant appearance, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`, which is right almost always; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame or a container that owns its own stacking context.
